profile.headline: Junior Software Developer @ Amerit Fleet Solutions | Full Stack Web Development
profile.summary:
Amerit Fleet Solutions benefits from my role as a Junior Software Developer, where I contribute to application development using Microsoft Azure and C#. My work focuses on maintaining and developing software solutions to meet organizational needs and improve operational efficiency.  

My foundation in Full-Stack Development, achieved through a certification from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, complements my practical experience. With a commitment to continuous learning, I aim to further enhance my technical skills and collaborate effectively with industry professionals to deliver impactful solutions.

projects.title: Vitality Vault
projects.description: Our website allows a user to make an account and login. As a user, you can set up your profile, and add your workout and fitness information to a secure database. You can view this information at anytime to help keep track of your fitness journey. It uses React and Express.js to interact with a GraphQL/MongoDB database along with Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Tech Blog
projects.description: This application allows the user to login or signup for a tech blog. This application allows the user to create blog post and edit them, as well as comment on any post on the homepage.
